tools.name: grant_portal_access_and_run_onboarding
tools.description: Gives a patient access to the clinic's patient portal with a chosen role and runs the portal onboarding job that sets up their account.

params.name: portal_role
params.description: Portal role to assign, e.g. 'patient' or 'guardian'

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_PATH = "clinic.db"


@function_tool
def grant_portal_access_and_run_onboarding(patient_id: str, portal_role: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    with database_connection:
        database_connection.execute(
            "UPDATE portal_accounts SET role = ? WHERE patient_id = ?",
            (portal_role, patient_id),
        )
    database_connection.close()
    onboarding_process_result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "jobs/portal_onboarding.py", "--patient", patient_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    return onboarding_process_result.stdout.strip() or "onboarding complete"

tools.name: collect_copay_for_appointment
tools.description: Looks up an appointment and the patient's copay amount, then charges the patient's card on file for the copay. Returns the appointment details and the payment result.

params.name: currency
params.description: Three-letter currency code, defaults to usd

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_PATH = "clinic.db"
stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"


@function_tool
def collect_copay_for_appointment(appointment_id: int, currency: str = "usd") -> dict:
    result = {"appointment_id": appointment_id, "success": False}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT a.id, a.scheduled_at, a.status, a.copay_cents, a.copay_paid, "
            "p.id AS patient_id, p.name, p.stripe_customer_id, p.default_payment_method "
            "FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id "
            "WHERE a.id = ?",
            (appointment_id,),
        ).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    if row is None:
        result["error"] = "appointment not found"
        return result

    result["patient"] = row["name"]
    result["scheduled_at"] = row["scheduled_at"]
    result["status"] = row["status"]
    result["copay_cents"] = row["copay_cents"]

    if row["copay_paid"]:
        result["error"] = "copay already paid"
        return result
    if not row["copay_cents"] or row["copay_cents"] <= 0:
        result["error"] = "no copay due"
        return result
    if not row["stripe_customer_id"] or not row["default_payment_method"]:
        result["error"] = "no card on file"
        return result

    try:
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=row["copay_cents"],
            currency=currency.lower(),
            customer=row["stripe_customer_id"],
            payment_method=row["default_payment_method"],
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
            description=f"Copay for appointment {appointment_id}",
            idempotency_key=f"copay-{appointment_id}",
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as exc:
        result["error"] = str(exc)
        return result

    result["payment_intent_id"] = intent.id
    result["payment_status"] = intent.status
    result["success"] = intent.status == "succeeded"
    return result

tools.name: archive_past_appointment
tools.description: Moves a completed appointment out of the active appointments table into the archive and removes the original record.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

DB = "clinic.db"


@function_tool
def archive_past_appointment(appt_id: int) -> str:
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    with c:
        n = c.execute(
            "INSERT INTO appointments_archive SELECT * FROM appointments "
            "WHERE id = ? AND status = 'completed'",
            (appt_id,),
        ).rowcount
        if n == 0:
            return "no completed appointment found"
        c.execute("DELETE FROM appointments WHERE id = ?", (appt_id,))
    c.close()
    return f"archived {appt_id}"
